in_sanskrit.name: सुयश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Suyash is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'yash' meaning auspicious. It is a name that signifies prosperity, good luck, and success.

in_hindi.name: सुयाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Suyash in Hindi is a combination of the words 'su' which means good and 'yash' which means auspicious. It is a name that is full of positive energy and is believed to bring good fortune.

in_tamil.name: சுயாஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Suyash in Tamil is derived from the Tamil words 'சு' (su) meaning good and 'யாஷ்' (yash) meaning auspicious. It is a name that is full of positivity and is believed to bring good luck and success.

in_telugu.name: శుయాష్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Suyash in Telugu is a combination of the words 'శు' (shu) which means good and 'యశ్' (yash) which means auspicious. It is a name that is full of positivity and is believed to bring good fortune and success.

in_marathi.name: Suyash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suyash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings good or prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Suyash
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good, Prosperous
in_bengali.long_meaning: Suyash একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who brings good or prosperity.
